interface.name: hsl_image_manager_v1
interface.description: This protocol negotiates opaque session tickets for the separately versioned HSL image transport. It never transports an OHOS handle, pointer, Vulkan object or DMA-BUF descriptor. Each pool is a distinct generation. The renderer authenticates its actual context and queue. Supported formats and usage are checked by the real image allocator.

interface.name: hsl_image_pool_v1
interface.description: offered contains exactly HSL_IMAGE_WORDS little-endian uint32 values from venus_shared_image.h, including the consumer's random ticket and accepted descriptor. The producer performs HI_CREATE before creating buffers. All pixels and GPU dependencies use that private transport. A buffer may be attached only after HI_PUBLISH succeeds. Reuse requires both wl_buffer.release and a successful HI_ACQUIRE. release does not imply GPU completion: the transport imports the actual GPU dependency. Destroying the pool does not prematurely free live buffers or jobs.
